name: paper_id
description: Stable row identifier assigned during curation.

name: pdf_filename
description: Exact PDF filename in the dataset pdfs folder.

name: paper_title
example_answer: Imaging neuropeptide release at synapses with a genetically engineered reporter

name: doi
description: Digital Object Identifier for the article.

name: species
description: Species used for the primary biological experiment.
expected_format: Common or Latin species name; include multiple species only if primary assays require both.

name: brain_region_or_neural_cell_type
description: Brain region, neural preparation, or principal neural/glial cell type assayed.

name: perturbation_or_condition
description: Experimental perturbation, genotype, stimulation, drug, or condition central to the main result.
expected_format: Concise intervention phrase; include control comparison if needed.

name: primary_assay_or_readout
description: Main assay or readout used to support the primary conclusion.
expected_format: Technique plus readout, not a full sentence.
evidence_expectation: Results section, figure legend, and methods.

name: key_quantitative_result
description: Main numerical result tied to the primary readout.
expected_format: Short result with value, unit, direction, and comparator when available.
evidence_expectation: Result paragraph or figure/legend; may require reading graph axes.
example_answer: EPSC amplitude decreased by 35% versus control

name: main_mechanistic_conclusion
description: Primary mechanistic interpretation supported by the paper.
evidence_expectation: Discussion plus primary results; avoid overclaiming beyond the paper.
example_answer: Latrophilin signaling promotes synapse formation through a GPCR-dependent pathway.

name: figure_panel_for_primary_result
description: Figure panel that best supports the key quantitative result or mechanism.
expected_format: Figure panel label such as Fig. 3c.
